instruction: Candid winter photograph, medium close-up. On a snowy outdoor street, the blonde woman in a beige coat and plaid scarf (R1) stands on the left in profile. The bearded man in a fur-hooded parka (R2) stands on the right, leaning forward to blow warm air onto her hands, which he holds gently in his own. Overcast daylight casts a soft glow over the scene, highlighting the muted winter tones.
